summary: Implemented --file and -f export flags, automatic format deduction (.txt/.tree -> FormatTree, .json -> FormatJson, .yaml/.yml -> FormatYaml, .md -> FormatMd), non-flag wildcard glob interception preventing Windows path syntax crashes, and parent directory auto-creation on export.
verification: Targeted test 'go test -v ./cmd/folder' in cli passed all 11 tests with 0 failures.

acceptance.VG-01: PASS TestParseArgs_WildcardPositional and TestParseArgs_CombinedTargetAndGlob verify positional wildcard *.go sets TargetDir='.', populates IncludeGlobs and Extensions without path syntax crash
acceptance.VG-02: PASS TestParseArgs_FileExportFlags and TestDeduceFormatFromExt verify -f 'a.txt' and -f 'a.tree' deduce FormatTree preserving branch layout
acceptance.VG-03: PASS TestParseArgs_FileExportFlags and TestDeduceFormatFromExt verify -f 'a.json' sets OutFile and FormatJson
acceptance.VG-04: PASS TestParseArgs_FileExportFlags and TestDeduceFormatFromExt verify -f 'a.yaml' and -f 'a.yml' set OutFile and FormatYaml
acceptance.VG-05: PASS TestParseArgs_ExplicitFormatPrecedence verifies explicit format flags override extension deduction
acceptance.VG-06: PASS TestScanDirectory_IncludeGlobs verifies IncludeGlobs filters files while descending into nested directories
acceptance.VG-07: PASS TestWriteOrPrintOutput_NestedDirectories verifies automatic parent directory creation on file persistence
